notes: The Blink example uses the on-board LED; the optional external LED circuit (LED + 220 ohm resistor) is what is built here.

Breadboard coordinates are read from the image: the upper half is labelled rows f-j, so it is mapped to bank 'b' (rows f-j). The strip for column 3 joins the orange wire (3b.g) and resistor leg 1 (3b.h). The strip for column 8 joins the LED cathode (8b.i) and the black wire (8b.g).
The LED's bent (long) leg in column 6 is taken as the anode, in line with the text. The resistor links pin 13 to the anode. The cathode returns to the GND pin next to pin 13 (GND.1).
The Uno is not powered by a USB cable in the figures, so none is added.
